record.title: Compose supplied-record RAW AC statistics
record.intent: Reuse unwindowed sampled AC statistics independently of frequency and experiment-specific qualification.
requirements: Add a pure typed mho-rf library API for supplied qualified RAW records with exact byte and acquisition metadata rebinding before statistics. Return named frozen validated accepted or rejected outcomes, evidence hashes, arithmetic DC, original-voltage extrema/Vpp and unwindowed demeaned population AC RMS with geometry and duration metadata.

Preserve exact constant and zero semantics without mistaking tiny varying samples for constants or silently underflowing their metric. Reject unrepresentable derived values explicitly. Keep receive guard, engineering thresholds, device access and experiment conditions outside the primitive.

Add a thin Click rf raw-ac-inspect endpoint through existing bounded supplied-file delegates and TOML output. Add a synthetic documented walkthrough distinguishing AC statistics from receive qualification; do not alter sealed runs, prior receipts or default receive semantics.

Validate known sine/DC, non-sinusoidal and off-bin input, exact constant, tiny varying and unrepresentable values, malformed input, forged bytes/metadata, file and CLI equivalence, preservation and rejected outcomes. Run workspace quality and installed-wheel consumer checks; commit and push verified implementation.
acceptance: The reusable supplied-record metric and CLI have meaningful numerical and consumer witnesses without changing the physical experiment or archived evidence.
